checks: exact bytes use the original native chunks without a copy
short body aborts before it can complete
long body aborts before it can complete
non-byte body aborts before it can complete
upstream disconnect has a transport-specific reason
a pending upstream read times out and cancels the source
client backpressure does not consume the upstream wait budget
cumulative upstream waits bound a slow drip response
client cancellation aborts the lookup and releases the source
invalid stream, byte and timeout bounds are rejected
scope: Local Node native-stream helper tests; no actual-WASM or cloud latency claims.
